name: Hoành Bồ guava
summary: Ổi Hoành Bồ is a local guava, sold by the bag of about 5 kg and up at phố đi bộ Bài Thơ.
origin: Hạ Long. A local specialty. Hoành Bồ is the old district name.
howToEat: Sold by the bag. The bags were about 5 kg and larger.
where: Phố đi bộ Bài Thơ, at the opening the tourism article describes.
seoTitle: Oi Hoanh Bo — the Ha Long guava
seoDescription: Ổi Hoành Bồ is a Hạ Long guava sold in bags of about 5 kg and up at phố đi bộ Bài Thơ.
